answer_1.quote: We evaluate our method on four different text generation tasks: generative commonsense reason-ing , recipe generation , data-grounded dialogue response generation , and reducing gender bias in machine translation .
datasets: hotel and restaurant dialogue system corpus
answer_1.outputs: coherent sentences, cooking instructions, dialogue responses, translations

answer_2.quote: We use several widely-used automatic metrics to automatically assess the performance, such as BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, which mainly focus on measuring surface similarities. We also include metrics specially designed for captioning task, such as CIDEr, and SPICE. Following Lin et al. ( ), we report the concept Coverage, which is the average percentage of input concepts that are present in lemmatizatized outputs.
